chunks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَرْقِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَالٍ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: From his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah, from Ahmad Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Tha'laba ibn Maymun, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: الرِّجَالُ ثَلَاثَةٌ: عَاقِلٌ وَأَحْمَقُ وَفَاجِرٌ، فَالْعَاقِلُ الدِّينُ شَرِيعَتُهُ، وَالْحِلْمُ طَبِيعَتُهُ، وَالرَّأْيُ سَجِيَّتُهُ، إِنْ سُئِلَ أَجَابَ، وَإِنْ تَكَلَّمَ أَصَابَ، وَإِنْ سَمِعَ وَعَى، وَإِنْ حَدَّثَ صَدَقَ، وَإِذَا اطْمَأَنَّ إِلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ وَفَى، وَالْأَحْمَقُ إِنْ اسْتَنْبَهَ بِجَمِيلٍ غَفَلَ، وَإِنْ اسْتُنْزِلَ عَنْ حَسَنٍ نَزَلَ، وَإِنْ حُمِّلَ عَلَى جَهْلٍ جَهِلَ، وَإِنْ حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، لَا يَفْقَهُ وَإِنْ فَقِهَ لَا يَتَفَقَّهُ، وَالْفَاجِرُ إِنْ ائْتَمَنْتَهُ خَانَكَ، وَإِنْ صَاحَبْتَهُ شَانَكَ، وَإِنْ وَثِقْتَ بِهِ لَمْ يُنْصِحْكَ

translations.en: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Men are of three types: the intelligent, the foolish, and the corrupt sinner. As for the intelligent one, religion is his path, forbearance is his nature, and good judgment is his disposition. If asked, he answers; if he speaks, he is correct; if he hears, he comprehends; if he narrates, he is truthful; and when one confides in him, he is loyal. As for the fool, if alerted to something beautiful, he overlooks it; if dissuaded from good, he acquiesces; if driven to ignorance, he becomes ignorant; and if he narrates, he lies. He does not understand, and if he does understand, he does not learn from it. As for the corrupt sinner, if you trust him, he betrays you; if you befriend him, he hates you; and if you rely on him, he is not sincere with you.

en.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) that men are divided into three categories: the intelligent (al-'Aqil), the foolish (al-Ahmaj), and the corrupt sinner (al-Fajir). The intelligent person is characterized by piety, forbearance, and truthfulness, while the fool lacks comprehension and learning, and the sinner is characterized by betrayal and insincerity.
en.seo_question: What are the three types of men described in Shia hadith and their distinguishing characteristics?

key_terms.عَاقِل: Intelligent person, one who possesses deep understanding and piety
key_terms.أَحْمَق: Foolish person, one who lacks comprehension and fails to learn
key_terms.فَاجِر: Corrupt sinner, one who transgresses and is untrustworthy
key_terms.شَرِيعَتُهُ: His path or law (referring to religion as his guiding principle)
